evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated across ophthalmic tasks, yet the methodological quality of these evaluations has received little attention.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Most studies report accuracy while overlooking design features required for valid and clinically meaningful inference.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: SIGHT provides twenty structured appraisal items to evaluate internal validity, interpretability, and applicability across diverse ophthalmic LLM study designs.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Common limitations include potential training-data contamination, inadequate handling of paired data, limited assessment of inter-rater reliability, inconsistent reference standards, insufficient evaluation of calibration and uncertainty, and frequent overinterpretation of benchmark performance as evidence of clinical readiness.

declaredVenue: 66 pages, 8 figures, 1 table. SIGHT appraisal framework (5 domains, 20 items)
